name: AGC-039 -- Privileged Group Enumeration
description: Disclosure: Executed & documented by Claude Code under direction and review by Hasan. | AGC-039: Targeted enumeration of privileged groups (Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, local administrators). Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: High.

techniques.comment: AGC-039: net.exe localgroup administrators and net.exe localgroup 'Remote Desktop Users' executed by Administrator on workstation. Local admin members revealed: Administrator, wadmin. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: High.

AGC-039: net.exe group 'Domain Admins' /domain and net.exe group 'Enterprise Admins' /domain attempted by Administrator on workstation. Both failed (error 1355, broken trust). The targeted query of privileged groups by name is the key indicator. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: High.
